messages:
alex: quick ask — planning a small canary for gptx-13b-oz tonight. can someone grab a smoke perf run (seq=1024, batch=4) and check p95/p99 + mem? tagging @sana @mike

sana: i can take it in ~30m. which quant/profile should i use? default float16 or try int8?

alex: start with float16 baseline, then int8 quantized profile we onboarded last week (oz-int8-v2). compare against our baseline tag baseline/gptx-13b-v1.

mike: FYI the runtime-bench infra has a new constraint on kernel selection — use --kernels=auto to let the compiler pick. avoids the bad conv kernel we saw earlier.

sana: got it. i'll run on dpool-gpu-6, 1 process, pinned to a single GPU. command i'll run:

```
./bench/run_infer.sh \
  --model gptx-13b-oz \
  --seq 1024 \
  --batch 4 \
  --quant float16 \
  --kernels auto \
  --samples 200
```

then repeat with --quant oz-int8-v2

sana: running now, should be ~8–10 mins per profile.

runtime-bot: bench job queued: job_id=rb-bench-9921, node=dpool-gpu-6, ETA ~9m

jorge: ping if you see any OOMs — we had ephemeral spikes with 1024 seq on 13B in fwk v1.2.1. set SWAP_LIMIT=0.2 if you need to throttle.

sana: quick note — baseline float16 finished. summary below. will run int8 next.

```
RESULTS baseline/fp16:
- throughput: 3.4k tokens/s (aggregate)
- p50: 28ms / token
- p95: 115ms
- p99: 198ms
- per-GPU resident: 18.6GB
- kv-cache mem steady: 4.2GB
- observed tail GC spikes: none
```

alex: thanks. that p99 is acceptable relative to SLA but per-GPU mem is a hair high. what's int8 look like?

sana: int8 run done. summary:

```
RESULTS oz-int8-v2:
- throughput: 4.1k tokens/s
- p50: 24ms
- p95: 105ms
- p99: 185ms
- per-GPU resident: 13.1GB
- kv-cache mem steady: 4.0GB
- accuracy quick-check on eval set: 99.2% of baseline output tokens preserved (simple ngram overlap)
```

mike: nice — int8 buys ~20% throughput and ~5.5GB memory savings. any regression flags from the accuracy check?

sana: nothing major on smoke eval, but we should run a full quality eval overnight. i'll kick off an eval job against our ref prompts (coverage ~5k).

jorge: can we test rollout policy? suggest canary=5% traffic to oz-int8-v2 with auto-fallback to fp16 if p99 > 250ms for 10m window.

alex: agree. also add a metric alert for token-drop anomalies and any delta in top-1 output mismatch >2% vs baseline for the canary window.

sana: created canary config draft in infra repo and pushed a PR: refs/pull/2043 — includes rollout, fallback, and observability tags.

mike: i'll review the PR in a bit. quick ask for runtime folks: on the int8 run I saw a small kernel warning log: "kernel mismatch fallback to scalar" — @tasha can you check if that's a compilation mismatch or expected on dpool-gpu-6?

tasha: I'll look. that log means we hit a path where fused-attn wasn't selected. could be due to driver/kernel combination on that node. I'll repro locally with the same cuda/driver and check.

tasha: quick repro shows fused-attn available but selector picked slower kernel when batch<8 at seq=1024. need to adjust selector threshold. filing issue: infra/selector#118.

alex: good catch — please include selector fix in the canary but don't block rollout unless p99 regresses. we want the memory wins from int8 asap.

runtime-bot: canary rollout scheduled at 2026-03-18T02:15:00Z for 5% traffic to oz-int8-v2 (canary id cb-7782)

jorge: for tracking — creating a short checklist:
- [x] smoke perf fp16 (sana)
- [x] smoke perf int8 (sana)
- [ ] full quality eval (sana)
- [ ] PR review for rollout (mike)
- [ ] selector fix (tasha)
- [ ] alerting + fallback config (alex)

alex: perfect. leave this thread open and paste final canary dashboard link when live. thanks team :rocket:

mike: quick note — if full eval shows >1% top-1 drift, pause canary and escalate to product. otherwise proceed.

sana: will update with full eval results here in ~6h.

runtime-bot: job rb-ev-447 queued: full-quality-eval (prompts=5k). ETA ~6h

sana: final update — full eval finished: 0.9% top-1 drift, p99 steady at 188ms, no memory regressions. proceeding to schedule the canary as planned.

alex: excellent — thanks everyone. launching canary per runtime-bot schedule.

runtime-bot: canary cb-7782 started: 5% traffic -> oz-int8-v2. dashboard: https://dash.redwood.ai/cb-7782

jorge: monitoring dashboard now. resources look solid. will post if anything spikes.

mike: PR merged for rollout config. :thumbsup:

alex: closing thread when canary passes 1h with no alerts. otherwise re-open.

sana: marking this done for bench & smoke runs. will reopen if eval flags anything.
